name: Marek Laco
current_role: Acting head, Employment and Training Administration (deputy assistant secretary since February 2025)
summary: Marek Laco joined the Employment and Training Administration in February 2025 as its chief of staff and deputy assistant secretary. Labor’s leadership page lists him as acting assistant secretary, running the agency after Henry Mack left in July 2026 to become Florida’s education commissioner.
